records.version: RE4(2005) young agent brown shearling jacket/black shirt/dark tactical trousers, replacing RPD-looking base without modifying its archived PNG.
records.identity: Leon S.Kennedy RE4 original2005 agent. Blond side-part hair, brown leather shearling-lined jacket, fitted black shirt, dark-gray tactical trousers with thigh holster, gloves and boots. Exact clothing from supplied new reference, NO RPD armor or letters. Simple attack uses real SILVER GHOST compact silver-slide black-grip handgun, held correctly with both hands. Not Special Rocket Launcher in this basic kit. No magical beam or martial weapon.
rows: IDLE: 1 relaxed low-ready pistol at waist, knees slightly bent; 2 weight on back foot checking forward, left hand adjusting grip; 3 deeper breath chest rising/head slightly forward, muzzle still low; 4 returns balanced stance with head turned slightly right and offhand supporting pistol.

RUN: four distinct consecutive running stride beats to right, alternating leg extension and bent passing pose, body leaning forward, handgun secured close to chest, never firing while running; all boots and coat complete.

ATTACK SILVER GHOST: 1 draws pistol up with elbow bent; 2 extends into two-handed aiming stance toward right; 3 fires ONE compact visible yellow muzzle flash just at muzzle, recoil through wrists and shoulders; 4 muzzle settles down slightly and bent knees recover. Full body normal scale and gun complete in every cell.

HIT: 1 startled upper-body recoil with pistol lowered; 2 twists shoulder back and braces left forearm; 3 crouches with one knee bent catching balance; 4 recovers low guarded stance. Non-graphic no blood, no prone corpse, no duplicated poses.

records.version: Sol Badguy Strive red-black cropped jacket/dark trousers, long brown ponytail/headband and broad red-black mechanical OutrageMkII.
records.identity: SOL BADGUY from GUILTY GEAR STRIVE, muscular man, long spiky BROWN hair tied in long ponytail, red headband, open cropped RED/BLACK jacket exposing chest, DARK trousers, multiple belts/straps, red/black heavy boots. Match supplied Strive outfit, not old white pants. His weapon OUTRAGE MK.II is broad massive RECTANGULAR RED-AND-BLACK mechanical slab sword with black end and glowing orange inset, exactly like reference, NOT a long thin steel sword. Hold by a real handle, keep entire slab inside each cell, angled across own torso when needed.
rows: IDLE: 1 relaxed broad stance with OutrageMkII held low diagonally; 2 rests slab on shoulder, weight shifts; 3 lowers chin and adjusts gloved grip with offhand; 4 stands ready with slab low across side and ponytail settled. Four distinct anatomies.

RUN: four consecutive powerful stride beats right, alternating legs and passing step, torso forward, heavy OutrageMkII tucked diagonally along body, ponytail swaying safely within cell, no cropped sword/hair.

ATTACK OUTRAGE MK.II: 1 winds heavy slab back beside shoulder; 2 steps in and draws broad red-black slab across body; 3 contact beat cutting diagonally DOWN-RIGHT with BOTH hands supporting control and only tiny orange contact spark, no huge arc; 4 follows through low with bent knee and draws slab back. Four full-body physical weapon poses, no fist-only TyrantRave, no GunFlame.

HIT: 1 shoulder knocked back and slab lowered; 2 leans rearward bracing free hand; 3 crouches with slab held close and ponytail curling; 4 recovers firm guarded stance. No blood, no gore, no duplicate drawings.

records.version: Ky Kiske Strive short blond hair/white-blue coat/dark trousers, silver-blue Thunderseal sword.
records.identity: KY KISKE, GUILTY GEAR STRIVE version. Short blond hair, WHITE long short-sleeve coat with BLUE lining/trim, fitted blue/dark inner shirt, DARK navy trousers, belts, blue/white footwear and gloves. Match supplied new presentation reference. THUNDERSEAL is a physical elegant straight SILVER blade with BLUE hilt/guard, not a red mechanical sword, no long ponytail, not older flowing religious robes. Keep full straight blade inside its cell by diagonal angle; subtle small blue electrical spark on contact only, no giant lightning sphere.
rows: IDLE: 1 sword low diagonal right, calm alert stance; 2 shifts rear foot and raises guard slightly; 3 breathes with shoulders higher and offhand relaxed; 4 settles with different weight/grip and coat tails moved. Four genuinely different full-body poses.

RUN: four distinct consecutive sword-carrying running beats right, alternating legs and bent passing positions, coat tails safely in cell, sword held diagonal near torso, no firing projectile and no blade beyond border.

ATTACK THUNDERSEAL: 1 raises silver-blue sword near left shoulder windup; 2 steps forward leading with blade; 3 diagonal descending cut toward right with a SMALL blue contact spark near blade only, physical sword complete and body full size; 4 follows through low and pulls guard back. No RideTheLightning giant ring or dragon transformation.
HIT: 1 upper torso recoils with lowered sword; 2 twists away bracing offhand; 3 bends knee to catch balance; 4 returns toward guarded posture. Full feet/sword visible, no gore or repeated cells.
